author: smitdalt
body: Once the alerts are implemented into the website and you can add friends again, I think you should be able to send private messages to people on your friends list through the website. Obviously there is skype, but not everyone has that and some people want to keep their skype private. Not sure if something like this is already being worked on, but I think it would be a nice addition.
